dogecoin.text:
"What if we have a Civil War, a Great Depression and a revolution in politics and business at the same time? And that's what we're looking at."

If this plays out, I like Occidental Petroleum and Dogecoin.

If you invested $10,000 in Dogecoin in the beginning of the year it would be worth $0 if you didn’t actually do this.

But if you really did, then it would be worth more than $1 million today.
